metrics.deviations_planned: Swap candidates are every other movable object / target present, whether or not the composed instruction is a task of the suites (role-phrase servers get the extra compositions in their lookup tables); in scene 2 the objects are the mugs.  The side queries draw the real query's noise (server counters restored).  Phase labels use a per-step ProprioHeld in the client; a role-phrase server's own detector steps per query (absent / nonsense words reach rung servers as a phrase override in the slot the client's phase names; mismatches are counted).  For absent / nonsense words a rung's front end keeps the true task's routing and painting; front ends on frozen policies receive the word as an unknown entity (every movable object painted). metrics.prediction:
STEER (SR 74): predictions, written 2026-11-16 BEFORE any probe job (smoke or main).  Not revised after anything below.
Source: docs/PLAN_PAPER.md 2c; reports/predictor_targets.md (Tables A, B, D, E).  Probabilities are mine, from the existing record only.

Setup the predictions refer to: steerability probe by counterfactual instruction (side queries, never executed) inside closed-loop
rollouts of the trained tasks K1-K4, K6 (scene 1; tids 0 2 4 6 10) and K1, K2 (scene 2); 10 states per task per policy.
steer_q = 1 when the side chunk's summed xyz delta points nearer the swapped-in entity than the trained one.
g_s(o) = mean steer over grasp-phase queries swapped to o; p_s(t) = mean over place-phase queries swapped to t; s_hat(o,t) = g_s(o) p_s(t).

P1  Grasp steering is high for every policy that reads language at all.  Frozen pi0.5, GR00T, pi0 and SmolVLA: mean g_s over words
    (cheese, wine bottle, bowl) >= .60 for pi0.5 (P .70), >= .55 for GR00T (P .55), >= .55 for pi0 (P .50), >= .55 for SmolVLA (P .40).
    X-VLA (language-weak per SR 45.3): mean g_s < .60 (P .55).
P2  Place steering is lower than grasp steering for every frozen wrapper-free policy (diagnosis: the held object picks the destination, F1):
    mean p_s < mean g_s for pi0.5, GR00T, pi0 and SmolVLA (each P .75; all four P .45).  Frozen pi0.5 mean p_s in [.15, .50] (P .60).
P3  Front ends raise place steering relative to intact: p_s(tv) > p_s(I) on pi0.5 (P .70) and on GR00T (P .55); p_s(tvp) >= p_s(tv)
    on pi0.5 (P .55).  Ladder: p_s ordered R2 > R0 (P .70); R2b < R2 (P .60).
P4  The product predicts per-task new-pairing success of the frozen wrapper-free policies only weakly.
    T0 headline (wrapper-free cells: pi0.5, GR00T, pi0, SmolVLA; 24 cells): AUC point estimate >= .75 (P .35); AUC lower bound > .5 and
    point >= .75 (the registered pass) P .15.  Reason: labels are almost all negative for pi0 and SmolVLA (new success .02), so the AUC rests on
    pi0.5's six cells, and a joint bootstrap over 4 policies and 6 tasks has wide intervals.
    T0 on the full scene-1 set (all policies with a target): pass P .40.  Spearman over cells >= .40 on the full set (P .55).
P5  T1 (Spearman between policy-mean s_hat and policy-mean measured N1-N6 success over scene-1 policies with a target): rho >= .60 and
    lower bound > 0: P .40.  Point rho in [.3, .8] (P .60).
P6  T2 (leave-one-family-out, one-parameter calibration through the origin; families pi0.5-based, GR00T-based, pi0, SmolVLA): the calibrated
    s_hat has lower pooled LOFO mean absolute error than the constant (other families' mean success) in at least 3 of the 4 held-out
    families (P .35).  Within the pi0.5 family (12 policies x 6 tasks) cell-level Spearman >= .35 (P .55).
P7  Baselines.  Trained-task success alone: AUC on the wrapper-free cells within .15 of .5 (P .65); Spearman not above the product's point
    estimate (P .70).  Nonsense-word sensitivity (share of chunks whose direction changes by more than 30 degrees under a nonsense word,
    policy-level): AUC below the product's point estimate (P .60).
P8  Validity control.  For the absent-word query, the share of chunks pointing nearer the trained entity is within .15 of the true prompt's
    share, for pi0.5 intact (P .55), GR00T intact (P .50), pi0 (P .50), SmolVLA (P .50).  For tv-type front ends (absent word -> every movable
    object painted) it is not within .15 (P .60): the front end changes the image, not only the word.  True-prompt steer toward the swapped
    entity is under .15 (P .85) for every policy.
P9  Scene 2 (T3).  p_s(plate swap) on K1/K2 is <= .25 for frozen pi0.5 intact (P .65) and for frozen pi0 (P .65).  For pi0.5 tvp,
    p_s <= .25 (P .45): the front end paints the instructed plate only, so a plate-word swap changes the image.  s_hat(N1), s_hat(N2) < .25 for
    pi0.5 I (P .65); measured N1/N2 success of I and tvp is 0.000 (SR 50), so every scene-2 label is negative.
P10 The negative-result prior.  The probe will not separate policies that have identical language reading but different failures: on the
    frozen wrapper-free set, the rank of policies by mean s_hat will differ from the rank by measured success in at least one adjacent pair
    (P .70).
P11 The executed episodes are unchanged by the side queries (server counters and detector state restored; same noise): for the intact
    frozen pi0.5 on K1-K4, K6 states 4-13 the trained-task success equals the existing atlas/tv_frozen rows for those states in at least
    90% of episodes (P .60; the shared noise stream is the only thing I expect could differ).

metrics.tests:
SR 74: the steerability failure predictor, read (CPU, openpi venv, numpy only).  Registered mapping (fixed in the prereg row):

Per probed query (experiments/steer_probe.py record): d = summed xyz delta of a chunk's first 5 steps (X-VLA: the 5th target minus the hand;
the first 8 steps as a descriptive variant), v_old = p_old - eef, v_new = p_new - eef (simulator positions of the trained and the swapped-in
entity).  steer = 1 iff angle(d, v_new) < angle(d, v_old); queries with |d| < 1e-9 are dropped (counted).  Scored for the cf chunk (the
counterfactual instruction), the true chunk (sanity), the absent-word chunk (validity control) and the nonsense-word chunk.
  g_s(o) = mean steer(cf) over grasp-phase queries whose swapped-in object is o;  p_s(t) = mean over place-phase queries whose swapped-in
  target is t, per policy, pooled over trained tasks, states and queries.   s_hat(o, t) = g_s(o) * p_s(t).  No fitting.
Cells: (policy, new task), new tasks N1-N6 = (cheese, plate) (cheese, stove) (cheese, cabinet) (wine, plate) (wine, stove) (wine, bowl) in scene 1,
S2N1 (white mug, right plate) and S2N2 (yellow-white mug, left plate) in scene 2.  Target = the canonical measured row of results/flawed/steer/
targets.json (steer_targets.py).  Policies without a target (X-VLA) are probed and excluded from T0-T2.  Wrapper-free subset (headline) =
frozen pi0.5, GR00T, pi0, SmolVLA intact.
T0   label = cell success >= .5; AUC (ties .5) and Spearman (average ranks) of s_hat against label / success; bootstrap B = 2000, numpy
     default_rng(0), tasks and policies drawn jointly with replacement, cells = the drawn (policy, task) pairs that exist; draws with one
     class (AUC) or a constant vector (Spearman) are dropped and counted; CI = 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles.  PASS iff AUC >= .75 and CI lower > .5.
     Headline: wrapper-free cells.  Also reported: all scene-1 policies; all cells of both scenes.
T1   Spearman between policy-mean s_hat and policy-mean measured success over the 6 new tasks, across scene-1 policies; bootstrap over
     policies and tasks jointly.  PASS iff rho >= .6 and CI lower > 0.
T2   leave-one-family-out (families pi05 [front ends and ladder included], groot, pi0, smolvla): kappa = sum(y s) / sum(s^2) on the other
     families' cells; prediction clip(kappa s, 0, 1); mean absolute error on the held-out family against the constant (the other families'
     mean success).  PASS iff the calibrated s_hat beats the constant in at least 3 of the 4 families.  Within-family cell-level Spearman
     (bootstrap over tasks and the family's policies) is reported alongside.
T3   scene 2: p_s of the plate-word swap on K1, K2 (pooled and per plate), s_hat(S2N1, S2N2), against measured N1, N2.  SUPPORTS the diagnosis
     iff every probed input-only policy has pooled p_s <= .25.
Baselines (same cells, same bootstrap; policy-level scores): trained-task success alone (mean success of the probe's own K1-K4, K6 episodes);
nonsense-word sensitivity = share of probed queries whose nonsense-word chunk differs in direction from the true chunk by more than 30 degrees.
Validity: absent = share of absent-word chunks nearer p_old than p_new; true = the same for the true chunk; valid iff |absent - true| <= .15.
